cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('src/eywa/offline.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = s[s.index('    def certificate(self):'):s.index('    def _recover(self, plan, objects):')]
new = '''    def certificate(self):
        records = []
        corpus = []
        index_of = {}
        analysis = self._analysis
        for number, run in enumerate(self.runs):
            if not isinstance(run, dict):
                raise InvalidCampaign("run must be an object")
            entry = run.get("entry")
            plan = self.plans_by_entry.get(entry)
            if plan is None:
                records.append({"status": "INVALID_TEST"})
                continue
            try:
                objects = assign(decode(run.get("ktest")), plan.harness.leaves)
                values = self._recover(plan, objects)
                key = identity_key(entry, plan.param_names, values)
                verdict = analysis.get(key)
                if verdict is None:
                    verdict = self._analyse(plan, key, values)
                    analysis[key] = verdict
                # The flag attests to pipe acceptance only; a mismatch
                # invalidates the test even if a predicate would reject it.
                consistent = plan.flag is None or \\
                    (objects[plan.flag] == 1) == verdict[1]
                result = None
                if plan.harness.result is not None:
                    result = read_value(plan.harness.result[1], objects)
            except InvalidTest:
                records.append({"status": "INVALID_TEST"})
                continue
            except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive only
                sys.stderr.write("campaign warning: run %d: %r\\n"
                                 % (number, exc))
                records.append({"status": "INVALID_TEST"})
                continue
            if not consistent:
                records.append({"status": "INVALID_TEST"})
                continue
            if verdict[2] != "OK":
                records.append({"status": verdict[2]})
                continue
            cost, commands = verdict[3], verdict[4]
            case = index_of.get(key)
            if case is None:
                case = len(corpus)
                index_of[key] = case
                corpus.append({
                    "entry": entry,
                    "inputs": {name: values[name] for name in plan.param_names},
                    "cost": cost,
                    "commands": commands,
                    "witnesses": [number],
                })
                records.append({"status": "READY", "case": case,
                                "model_result": result})
            else:
                corpus[case]["witnesses"].append(number)
                records.append({"status": "DUPLICATE", "case": case,
                                "model_result": result})
        return {
            "plans": [plan.dump() for plan in self.plans],
            "records": records,
            "corpus": corpus,
        }

'''
s = s.replace(old, new)
p.write_text(s)
